description-en: WeChat mini-program standard: 2-5 tabs, icon + label, fixed at bottom. Active tab: accent color icon + text. Inactive: gray. Tab bar height 50px + safe-area padding. Never use more than 5 tabs. Never mix text-only and icon-only tabs in the same bar.
description-zh: 微信小程序标准：2-5 个标签，图标+文字，底部固定。激活标签主色图标+文字，未激活灰色。标签栏高 50px + 安全区。禁止超过 5 个标签、禁止同一栏混用纯文字和纯图标。

description-en: The primary content pattern for mini-programs: a vertical scroll of cards, each with an image (16:9 or 1:1), title, 1-line description, and metadata row. Cards have 12px border-radius and a fine separator. Gap between cards: 12px. Pull-down to refresh, pull-up to load more.
description-zh: 小程序核心内容模式：纵向卡片信息流，每张卡片含图（16:9 或 1:1）、标题、一行描述、元数据行。12px 圆角、细分割线。卡片间距 12px。下拉刷新、上拉加载更多。

description-en: A horizontal swiper/carousel at the top of the page. 2-5 panels, auto-play optional (3s interval). Dots indicator below, active dot in accent color. Aspect ratio 2:1 or 16:9. Never auto-play when the user has reduced-motion preference. Always show the dot indicator — never hide it.
description-zh: 页面顶部横向轮播，2-5 面板，可选自动播放（3s 间隔）。下方圆点指示器，激活点主色。宽高比 2:1 或 16:9。用户开启减少动效时禁止自动播放。始终显示圆点，不可隐藏。

description-en: Each field: label on top, input below, error text below input in red #E53E3E. Validate on blur. Submit button at the bottom, full-width, 44px height, disabled until all fields pass. Required fields marked with a red asterisk. Phone number fields trigger the numeric keyboard.
description-zh: 每个字段：标签在上、输入框在下、错误提示红字 #E53E3E 在输入框下。失焦时校验。底部提交按钮全宽、44px 高、全部通过前禁用。必填项红色星号。手机号字段唤起数字键盘。

description-en: Replace the default WeChat nav bar with a custom one. Height: capsule-button-safe (varies by device, ~44px on modern iPhones). Back button left (← arrow), title centered, optional action button right. Background: white with a bottom hairline. Set navigationStyle to 'custom' in app.json.
description-zh: 用自定义导航栏替换微信默认栏。高度适配胶囊按钮（因设备而异，新 iPhone ~44px）。左返回箭头、标题居中、右侧可选操作按钮。白底底部发丝线。app.json 设 navigationStyle 为 custom。

name-zh: 下拉刷新 + 上拉加载
description-en: Enable pull-down refresh (enablePullDownRefresh: true) with a custom loading spinner in the accent color. On refresh, reset page to 1. Scroll to bottom triggers load-more (onReachBottom): append page+1 results, show a 'loading' footer. If no more data, show '— No more —' in tertiary text. Never show both spinners simultaneously.
description-zh: 开启下拉刷新（enablePullDownRefresh: true），自定义主色加载动画。刷新时重置页码为 1。滚到底触发加载更多（onReachBottom），追加下一页结果，底部显示'加载中'。无更多数据时显示'— 没有更多了 —'三级灰色。禁止两个加载动画同时出现。

description-en: A bottom sheet with a list of actions (e.g., Share, Report, Block). Title at top, action rows in the middle, Cancel button at the bottom separated by a 6px gap. Action rows: 48px height, centered text. Destructive actions in red. Cancel in bold. Backdrop: rgba(0,0,0,0.4). Slide-up animation 0.3s.
description-zh: 底部面板，含操作列表（如分享、举报、拉黑）。顶部标题，中部操作行，底部取消按钮以 6px 间距分隔。操作行高 48px，文字居中。破坏性操作红字。取消加粗。遮罩 rgba(0,0,0,0.4)。上滑动画 0.3s。
